text:
Type: upholstered barrel-back dining chair
Use: dining, extra seating; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: woven fabric upholstery with topstitching, solid wood legs in a dark finish
Colors: mustard yellow, dark brown wood
Shape: curved wraparound low back that forms the arms, padded seat, vertical stitch lines, four tapered square legs, wide and cosy, medium visual weight
Feel: cheerful, cosy, warm
Goes with: walnut tables, grey or white walls, navy or teal accents; mid-century or eclectic rooms

product.name: Rivet Alfred Mid-Century Modern Wide Curved Back Accent Kitchen Dining Room Chair, 25.2"W, Canary Yellow (Renewed)
product.description: This classic mid-century modern accent chair features a wide curved back and armrest combined with simple tapered legs. Plenty of padding makes it sturdy and comfortable to use in the dining room or anywhere else extra seating is needed. 25.2W" x 23.2"D x x31.9"H Fabric is 100% polyester. Hardwood legs with espresso finish. Foam padding and elastic suspension system keep back and seat firm and springy Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Simple assembly; just attach legs. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
